content: संक्रान्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Going together, union. .²2 Passage from one point to another, transition. .²3 The passage of the sun or any planetary body from one zodiacal sign into another. .²4 Transference, giving over (to another); संपातिताः … पयसो गण्डूषसंक्रान्तयः <ls>U. 3. 16</ls>. .²5 Transferring or communicating (oneʼs knowledge to another), power of imparting (instruction to another); विवादे दर्शयिष्यन्तं क्रियासंक्रान्तिमात्मनः <ls>M. 1. 19</ls>; शिष्टा क्रिया कस्यचिदात्मसंस्था संक्रान्तिरन्यस्य विशेषयुक्ता <ls n="M.">1. 16</ls>. .²6 Image, reflection. .²7 Depicting.
